author: TomShen10
body:
Hello, My name is TomShen10
On July 15 2014 I was banned from avic. This was a reasonable ban because I was swearing and such, at the time I being immature and stupid, I would like to say that I have changed, and if you un ban me you won't regret it, I have changed and I am thinking about donating to make up for the inappropriate way I acted on the server last year. I believe that the time I have spent off the server has been deserved, but I certainly believe that it has been long enough, I am changed, and when I was doing those things last year, I was very irresponsible. I would very much appreciate it if the Avic staff would at least take my unbanning into consideration, and I can guarantee that the infractions as of last year will not occur again. Thank you for your time and consideration.
Tom
